identityPolicy: Group by field + positive NIRCam_DR5_ID, never by program-local NIRSpec_ID. Missing photometric IDs retain independent observation IDs. All grouped observations retained. Incompatible z/coordinates are Atlas only. A/B/C priority chooses a representative, never invents a sigma. Full original cosmic source catalogue and final core checked for overlaps.
